summary: 关于火星生命的猜想，从早期的“运河”观察逐步转向探测器、陨石和地表水留下的证据。文章比较不同线索及其解释，并保留生命是否存在的问题。
logic: 从地图上的线条到运河猜想
用探测器与陨石寻找证据
重建磁场和气候的变化
检验液态水与生命线索

paragraphs.brief: 1877年，意大利天文学家Giovanni Schiaparelli绘制了火星表面的图和地图，显示有奇怪的特征。
sentences: In 1877, Giovanni Schiaparelli, an Italian astronomer, made drawings and maps of the Martian surface that suggested strange features.
1877年，意大利天文学家Giovanni Schiaparelli绘制了火星表面的图和地图，显示有奇怪的特征。
The images from telescopes at that time were not as sharp as today’s.
那时望远镜的图像并没有今天那么尖锐。
Schiaparelli said he could see a network of lines, or canali.
Schiaparelli说他可以看见一个线网，或者说Canali。

In 1894, an American astronomer, Percival Lowell, made a series of observations of Mars from his own observatory at Flagstaff, Arizona, U.S.A. Lowell was convinced a great network of canals had been dug to irrigate crops for the Martian race.
1894年，一位美国天文学家Percival Lowell在美国亚利桑那州Flagstaff的观测站对火星进行了一系列观测。Lowell确信，已经挖掘出一条巨大的运河网络，为火星种族灌溉农作物。
He suggested that each canal had fertile vegetation on either side, making them noticeable from Earth.
他建议说，每条运河两边都有肥沃的植被，从地球可以看到这些植被。
Drawings and globes he made show a network of canals and oases all over the planet.
他制作的图画和地球展示了整个星球的运河和绿洲网络

paragraphs.brief: 1898年，H. G. Wells撰写了经典科学小说《世界大战》 是关于火星人入侵地球的
sentences: The idea that there was intelligent life on Mars gained strength in the late 19ᵗʰ century.
19世纪末，火星上有智能生命的理念获得了力量。
In 1898, H. G. Wells wrote the science-fiction classic The War of the Worlds about an invading force of Martians who try to conquer Earth.
1898年，H. G. Wells撰写了经典科学小说《世界大战》 是关于火星人入侵地球的
They use highly advanced technology (advanced for 1898) to crush human resistance.
它们利用高度先进的技术(1898年先进)来压制人类的抵抗力。
In 1917, Edgar Rice Burroughs wrote the first in a series of 11 novels about Mars.
1917年埃德加·赖斯·伯勒斯写了11部关于火星的书
Strange beings and rampaging Martian monsters gripped the public’s imagination.
奇怪的生物和狂妄的火星怪兽抓住了公众的想象力。

A radio broadcast by Orson Welles on Halloween night in 1938 of The War of the Worlds caused widespread panic across America; people ran into the streets in their pyjamas—millions believed the dramatic reports of a Martian invasion.
1938年世界大战万圣节晚，Orson Welles的电台广播在全美国引起广泛的恐慌；人们穿着睡衣在街上跑，数百万人相信火星入侵的戏剧性报道。

paragraphs.brief: 1975年，美国派出了两枚维京探测器每人配备了轨道器和着陆器
sentences: Probes are very important to our understanding of other planets.
探矿对于我们了解其他行星非常重要
Much of our recent knowledge comes from these robotic missions into space.
我们最近的大部分知识来自这些机器人进入太空的飞行任务。
The first images sent back from Mars came from Mariner 4 in July 1965.
1965年7月从火星发回的第一批图像来自Mariner 4。
They showed a cratered and barren landscape, more like the surface of our Moon than Earth.
他们展示了一片荒芜的火山灰更像我们的月球表面而不是地球
In 1969, Mariners 6 and 7 were launched and took 200 photographs of Mars’s southern hemisphere and pole on fly-by missions, but these revealed little more information.
1969年，陆战队员6号和7号被发射，拍摄了200张火星南半球和北极飞行任务的照片，但这些照片只透露了很少的信息。
In 1971, Mariner 9 became the first spacecraft to orbit the planet, circling every 12 hours.
1971年，Mariner 9号成为第一个绕地球运行的航天器，每12小时旋转一次。
In 1975, the U.S.A. sent two Viking probes, each with an orbiter and a lander.
1975年，美国派出了两枚维京探测器每人配备了轨道器和着陆器
The landers had sampler arms to scoop up Martian rocks and carried out experiments to try to find signs of life.
登陆者有采样器的手臂挖出火星岩石并进行实验试图找到生命的迹象。
Although no life was found, they sent back the first colour pictures of the planet’s surface and atmosphere from pivoting cameras.
虽然没有找到生命，但是它们从穿透摄影机中发回了地球表面和大气的第一批彩色图片。

paragraphs.brief: 在地球上发现的一颗火星陨石使人们对上述分析产生新的怀疑。
sentences: A Martian meteorite found on Earth raised fresh doubts about the above analysis.
在地球上发现的一颗火星陨石使人们对上述分析产生新的怀疑。
Meteorite ALH 84001 was discovered in December 1984 in Antarctica by members of the ANSMET project.
1984年12月，南极洲气象气象卫星应用协会项目成员在南极洲发现了气象卫星ALH 84001。
The sample was ejected from Mars about 17 million years ago and spent 11 000 years in, or on, Antarctic ice sheets.
样本大约在1700万年前从火星上喷射出来，在南极冰盖中或冰盖上花费了11 000年。
NASA’s compositional analysis revealed a kind of magnetite that on Earth is only found in association with certain micro-organisms.
美国航天局的构成分析揭示了一种磁铁，在地球上只发现与某些微生物有关联。

Some structures resemble the mineralised casts of terrestrial bacteria and their appendages, fibrils or by-products occurring in the rims of carbonate globules and pre-terrestrial aqueous-alteration regions.
有些结构类似于在碳酸盐球和地球前水变区域边缘发生的陆生细菌及其附着物、纤维或副产品被矿化的石块。
The size and shape of the objects are consistent with Earthly fossilised nanobacteria, but the very existence of nanobacteria is still controversial.
物体的大小和形状与地球化的纳米细菌一致，但纳米细菌的存在本身仍然有争议。

paragraphs.brief: 1965年，Mariner 4号探测器发现，火星没有全球磁场来保护地球免受可能危及生命的宇宙和太阳辐射；1990年代末期，火星全球勘测员进行的观测证实了这一发现。
sentences: In 1965, the Mariner 4 probe discovered that Mars had no global magnetic field to protect the planet from potentially life-threatening cosmic and solar radiation; observations made in the late 1990s by Mars Global Surveyor confirmed this discovery.
1965年，Mariner 4号探测器发现，火星没有全球磁场来保护地球免受可能危及生命的宇宙和太阳辐射；1990年代末期，火星全球勘测员进行的观测证实了这一发现。
Scientists speculate that the lack of magnetic shielding helped the solar wind blow away much of Mars’s atmosphere over several billion years.
科学家推测，缺乏磁屏蔽有助于太阳风在数十亿年的时间里吹走火星大气的大部分。

After mapping cosmic-radiation levels at various depths on Mars, researchers concluded that any life within the first several metres of the planet’s surface would be killed by lethal doses of radiation.
在绘制火星不同深度的宇宙辐射水平之后，研究人员得出结论，地球表面最初几米之内的任何生命都会被致命剂量的辐射杀死。
In 2007 it was calculated that DNA and RNA damage would limit life on Mars to depths greater than 7.5 metres below the surface.
2007年，据计算，DNA和RNA的破坏将使火星上的生命限制在表层以下7.5米以上的深度。
Therefore, the best places to look for life may be subsurface environments that have not yet been studied.
因此，寻找生命的最佳地点可能是尚未研究的地下环境。
The disappearance of the magnetic field may have played a significant role in Martian climate change.
磁场的消失在火星气候变化中可能起了重要作用。
According to scientists’ evaluation, Mars’s climate gradually transitioned from warm and wet to cold and dry after the magnetic field vanished.
根据科学家的评估，火星的气候在磁场消失后逐渐从温暖和湿润向寒冷和干燥过渡。

paragraphs.brief: 美国航天局最近的飞行任务侧重于另一个问题：火星的表面是否在古老的过去有湖泊或海洋中的液体水。
sentences: NASA’s recent missions have focused on another question: whether Mars had lakes or oceans of liquid water on its surface in the ancient past.
美国航天局最近的飞行任务侧重于另一个问题：火星的表面是否在古老的过去有湖泊或海洋中的液体水。
Scientists have found hematite, a mineral that forms only in the presence of water.
科学家发现了热聚物一种矿物质只有在水中才能形成
Thus, the 2004 Mars Exploration Rovers were designed not to look for present or past life, but for evidence of ancient liquid water.
因此，2004年的火星探索潜水器的设计不是为了寻找现在或过去的生命，而是要寻找古代液体水的证据。
Because of Mars’s current low atmospheric pressure and temperature, liquid water cannot persist at the surface except, briefly, at the lowest shaded elevations.
由于火星目前的低大气压力和温度，液体水不可能在表面持续，除非是短暂地在最低的阴暗高地。
In March 2004, NASA announced that its rover Opportunity had discovered evidence that Mars was once a wet planet.
2004年3月，美国航天局宣布，它的漫游机会发现了火星曾是湿行星的证据。
This raised hopes that evidence of past life might still be found.
这使人们对仍然可以找到过去生活的证据抱有希望。
Later the Mars Express orbiter detected huge reserves of water-ice at Mars’s south pole in January 2004.
后来，火星快车于2004年1月在火星的南极发现了巨大的水冰储备。

paragraphs.brief: 来自西班牙天体生物学中心和智利北方天主教大学的研究人员在阿塔卡马沙漠表面下方两米处发现了一个微生物绿洲。
sentences: Researchers from the Center for Astrobiology (Spain) and the Catholic University of the North in Chile have found an oasis of micro-organisms two metres below the surface of the Atacama Desert.
来自西班牙天体生物学中心和智利北方天主教大学的研究人员在阿塔卡马沙漠表面下方两米处发现了一个微生物绿洲。
SOLID, a life-detection instrument, could be used in environments similar to Martian sub-soil.
SOLID是一种生命探测仪器，可用于类似于火星底土的环境。

“We have named it a microbial oasis because we found micro-organisms developing in a habitat rich in rock salt and other highly hygroscopic compounds that absorb water,” explained Víctor Parro of the Center for Astrobiology.
“我们把它命名为微生物绿洲，是因为我们发现微生物生长在一个富含岩盐和其他吸收水的高湿度化合物的生境中”，这是天文学中心Víctor Parro的解释。
“If similar microbes, or their remains, exist on Mars under comparable conditions, we could detect them with instruments like SOLID,” Parro added.
“如果类似的微生物或其遗骸在类似条件下存在于火星上，我们可以用SOLID等仪器探测到它们。”

paragraphs.brief: 这将表明火星和地球生命的共同起源。
sentences: Even more intriguing is an alternative scenario proposed by the Spanish scientists.
更有趣的是西班牙科学家提出的另一种设想。
If samples on Mars were found to use DNA—as Earthly life does—it would be extremely unlikely that such a specialised, complex molecule could have evolved independently on two planets.
如果发现火星上的样品使用DNA——如地球生物那样——那么，这种专门、复杂的分子不可能在两个行星上独立地演变。
This would indicate a common origin for Martian and Earth life.
这将表明火星和地球生命的共同起源。
Life based on DNA might have appeared first on Mars and then spread to Earth, where it evolved into the myriad plants and creatures alive today.
以DNA为基础的生命可能首先出现在火星上然后扩散到地球在那里，它演变成众多的植物和生物今天活着。
If that proved true, we would face a startling conclusion: we are all Martians.
如果事实证明确实如此，我们将面临一个令人吃惊的结论：我们都是火星人。
If not, we must continue the search for other signs of life.
否则，我们必须继续寻找其他生命迹象。

items.zh: 在地球上发现的火星证据
items.why: D 段从一块在地球上发现、来自火星的陨石写起，随后分析其成分，完全符合“在地球上找到的火星证据”这一线索。

items.en: Mars and Earth may share the same origin of life
items.zh: 火星和地球可能有着相同的生命起源
items.why: H 段提出，如果火星样本也有与地球相同的 DNA，这种复杂分子不大可能独立演化两次，因而两地生命可能有共同起源。

items.en: Detailed depiction of large-scale agricultural constructions
items.zh: 大规模农业建筑的详细描述
items.why: A 段写早期地图和火星仪上画满了贯穿行星的运河与绿洲网络，描述的是观察者所设想的大型灌溉设施。

items.en: A project that aims to detect life under conditions similar to those on Mars
items.zh: 旨在探测与火星上类似条件下的生活的项目
items.why: G 段介绍 SOLID 生命探测仪，以及在与火星地下环境相似的条件下寻找微生物的研究，既有项目也有特定环境。

items.en: Mars has undergone drastic climatic transformation
items.zh: 火星经历了巨大的气候变迁
items.why: E 段写火星失去磁场后，气候由温暖湿润逐渐变为寒冷干燥。这里清楚给出了气候变化的前后状态。

items.en: Scientific attempts to locate liquid water on Mars
items.zh: 在火星上寻找液体水的科学尝试
items.why: F 段介绍美国航天局的任务如何寻找古代湖泊或海洋曾存在的迹象，研究目标正是确认火星表面过去是否有液态水。

items.en: How did Percival Lowell describe Mars in this passage?
items.zh: 帕西瓦尔·洛威尔在这段话里如何描述火星？
correct: There are clear traces of water and agriculture similar to Earth’s.
水和农业的痕迹与地球相似。

items.en: How did people change their view of Mars from the 19th century onwards?
items.zh: 从19世纪开始人们如何改变他们对火星的看法？
correct: They absorbed new ideas through literary works.
他们通过文学作品吸收了新的思想。

items.en: According to the probes sent in the 1960s, which statement about Mars is correct?
items.zh: 根据1960年代发出的探测器火星的哪些说法是正确的？
correct: It appeared far less dynamic than Earth.
它看起来远不如地球那么有活力

items.en: What is the implication of the project using the technology called SOLID in the Atacama Desert?
items.zh: 在阿塔卡马沙漠使用称为SOLID的技术对该项目有何影响？
correct: It could be employed to explore organisms under Martian-like conditions.
它可以用来在火星式条件下探索生物。

items.en: According to The War of the Worlds, Martian technology surpassed that of humans in every field at the time.
items.zh: 根据《世界大战》，火星的技术超过了人类在当时的每个领域。
items.why: 小说中的火星侵略者利用先进技术击溃人类的抵抗。文中只涉及这场对抗，没有比较当时双方在所有领域的技术。

items.en: The evidence supplied by the Viking probes has never been challenged.
items.zh: 维京探测器提供的证据从未受到质疑。
items.why: 原文说一块后来在地球上发现的火星陨石让人重新质疑先前的分析。“从未受到质疑”与这项后续发现相矛盾。

items.en: Analysis of a meteorite from Mars discovered a substance associated with certain germs.
items.zh: 对火星陨石的分析发现一种与某些细菌有关的物质。
items.why: 陨石成分分析发现了一种磁铁矿，而在地球上这种矿物只与某些微生物一起出现，直接对应题干中与特定微生物有关的物质。

items.en: According to Víctor Parro, their project will be sent to Mars once DNA-based life has been identified on Earth.
items.zh: 维克托·帕罗说，一旦在地球上发现了DNA基生物，他们的项目将送往火星。
items.why: 帕罗说，如果火星在相似条件下存在微生物，可用 SOLID 一类仪器探测。这个条件谈的是能否探测，没有交代何时发射项目，更没有给出题干所说的地球 DNA 前提。

points: D 段从一块在地球上发现、来自火星的陨石写起，随后分析其成分，完全符合“在地球上找到的火星证据”这一线索。
原文说一块后来在地球上发现的火星陨石让人重新质疑先前的分析。“从未受到质疑”与这项后续发现相矛盾。
clauses: NASA’s compositional analysis revealed a kind of magnetite ….
“that on Earth is only found in association with certain micro-organisms”修饰前面的 kind。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 that 时，回看 kind，再把修饰信息接回主句。
In 1965, the Mariner 4 probe discovered … ; observations made in the late 1990s by Mars Global Surveyor confirmed this discovery.
“that Mars had no global magnetic field to protect the planet from potentially life-threatening cosmic and solar radiation”补足 discovered 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 discovered 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
